## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] I tested the change locally, or explained why testing was not possible.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I documented new configuration, behavior, and assumptions.
- [ ] I checked that generated results, secrets, local environment files, and unrelated files are not included.
- [ ] I preserved upstream attribution and checked applicable licenses for third-party code and datasets.

## Evidence / notes

Add test output, metrics, screenshots, or limitations here. Do not present synthetic results as real-world measurements.
